returns.amountCollected: The amount of protocol fees actually collected

donate((address,address,address,address,.details: Calls to donate can be frontrun adding just-in-time liquidity, with the aim of receiving a portion donated funds. Donors should keep this in mind when designing donation mechanisms.This function donates to in-range LPs at slot0.tick. In certain edge-cases of the swap algorithm, the `sqrtPrice` of a pool can be at the lower boundary of tick `n`, but the `slot0.tick` of the pool is already `n - 1`. In this case a call to `donate` would donate to tick `n - 1` (slot0.tick) not tick `n` (getTickAtSqrtPrice(slot0.sqrtPriceX96)). Read the comments in `Pool.swap()` for more information about this.

params.amount0: The amount of currency0 to donate
params.amount1: The amount of currency1 to donate
params.hookData: Any data to pass to the callback

returns.delta: The balance delta of the address donating

returns._0: The value of the slot as bytes32

params.slots: List of slots to SLOAD from.

getFeeGrowthGlobals(bytes32).details: feeGrowthGlobal can be artificially inflated by a malicious actor and integrators should be careful using the value For pools with a single liquidity position, actors can donate to themselves to freely inflate feeGrowthGlobal atomically donating and collecting fees in the same lockAcquired callback may make the inflated value more extreme

returns.feeGrowthGlobal0x128: The global fee growth for token0
returns.feeGrowthGlobal1x128: The global fee growth for token1

modifyLiquidity((address,address,address.details: feeDelta can be artificially inflated by a malicious actor and integrators should be careful using the value For pools with a single liquidity position, actors can donate to themselves to inflate feeGrowthGlobal (and consequently feeDelta) atomically donating and collecting fees in the same lockAcquired callback may make the inflated value more extreme

returns.delta: The total balance delta of the caller of modifyLiquidity.
returns.feeDelta: The balance delta of the fees generated in the liquidity range.
